title: Five variants
text: Primary, secondary, outline, ghost, and danger emphasis in three sizes.

title: Icons either side
text: An icon at the start or end, or an icon-only button with an accessible name.

title: Loading state
text: A busy button shows a spinner, blocks activation, and announces that it is loading.

title: Toggle buttons
text: Set pressed to make a toggle that reports its new state on every press.

title: Enhance or create
text: Upgrade an existing button or link, or create a new button in code.
